I recently released an update of the R package `farr` that provides data and code to support the book "Empirical Research in Accounting: Tools and Methods" to CRAN: [`farr` on CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=farr)

The update was needed in part to address changes in the upstream data sources ([current `farr` release notes](https://iangow.github.io/farr/news/index.html)).

One benefit of putting data and code in an R package is that a function can be introduced in one chapter and used in another without having to repeat the code or introduce dependencies between chapters. Also, it's an easy way to distribute small-ish data sets to students.

Some of the functions and data might be of interest even for researchers not using the book, such as the `winsorize()` function and the GVKEY-CIK table, `gvkey_ciks`.

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## Update - 26 October 2026

The current CRAN release is 1.1.1, published on 22 October 2026. For current code and data, use [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=farr) or the [maintained GitHub source](https://github.com/iangow/farr), with the [package documentation](https://iangow.github.io/farr/). The release-notes link above is a current substitute for the original upstream-data reference, which remains recorded in the LinkedIn original.
:::
